parameters.help_en: The group ID. Use it to associate groups
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
Billing type (pay-as-you-go by default if empty).

PayAsYouGo: Pay-as-you-go

Subscription: Subscription
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型（为空时默认后付费）。

PayAsYouGo：后付费
Subscription：预付费
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: Mobile phone number. Each mobile phone number corresponds to a template variable, an upstream extension code, and an external extension field. The maximum number of mobile phone numbers is 1000. Example: ["1234567890"]
parameters.help_zh: 手机号，每个手机号对应一个模板变量、上行拓展码和外部拓展字段，号码个数最大为1000，示例：["1234567890"]
parameters.name: phone_numbers

parameters.help_en: The send schedule ID. Use it to associate send schedules
parameters.help_zh: 发送计划ID，用于关联发送计划
parameters.name: schedule_id

parameters.help_en: Signature ID. Specify either the signature name or the signature ID
parameters.help_zh: 签名ID，同时只能指定签名名称或签名ID其中之一
parameters.name: signature_id

parameters.help_en: Template ID. Specify either the template Code or the template ID
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID，同时只能指定模板Code或模板ID其中之一
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The actual value corresponding to the SMS template variable, in JSON format. Supports multiple parameters. Example: [{"name":"Zhang San","number":"15038\\76"}]
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板变量对应的实际值，JSON格式。支持传入多个参数，示例：[{"name":"张三","number":"15038****76"}]
parameters.name: template_params
